title: Sap Advanced Business Application Programming Consultant
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!


Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for "SAP ABAP" Remote in Brazil who wants to learn and transform his career.


In this role you will: (responsibilities)


Prototype, design, develop, and maintain Mobile Application Integration Framework and its integration services to support mobile applications such as SAP Service and Asset Manager, SAP Maintenance Assistant, as well as other system-to-system integration scenarios such as S/4HANA and Asset Performance Management solution integration, S/4HANA Disconnected Defense, S/4HANA Last Mile Delivery, S/4HANA and Business Network Asset Collaboration solution integration etc.

Follow SAP’s development standard, efficient use of SAP ABAP programming model and development tools in development and testing, such as ABAP OO, ABAP RESTful Application Programming Model, BAPI, BAdI, Open SQL, RDBMS, SAPGUI, ABAP Development Tools for Eclipse, Web Dynpro for ABAP, Fiori Elements, SAP Gateway, OData Service, S/4HANA Private Cloud, S/4HAN Public Cloud, SAP ERP system etc.

Actively collaborate with product manager to clarify on customer problem, integration feature requirement

Setup and configure necessary S/4HANA system business processes (Plant Maintenance, Quality Management, Material Management, Inventory Management, Extended Warehouse Management, Work Clearance Management etc), setup necessary test data (Work Order, Notification, PM Confirmation, Timesheet, Service Order, Service Confirmation, Service Quotation, Equipment, Functional Location, Material Master etc), to support the development and test of integration services.

Collaborate with UX designers to ensure seamless and visually appealing user experience following SAP Fiori Design Guidelines when relevant.

Ensure high performance and responsiveness of developed features

Actively collaborate with frontend MDK developers to align on OData Service features and requirement, to ensure seamless integration between frontend and backend.

Conduct thorough testing, including ABAP unit test to fulfill code coverage requirement, backward compatibility, and prevent performance and feature regression with any new development and enhancement.

Actively collaborate with quality engineers on issues reported, debug, identify and fix bugs, short dumps, and performance issues

Provide sufficient documentations on features developed

Collaborate with user assistance developer (technical writer) to provide information on product features developed to be used in product documentation

Follow agile development principles and best practice during development

Participate in daily scrums

Participate in backlog grooming, and able to provide good quality effort estimates

Provide quick investigation and resolution to assigned customer incident from ServiceNow. Follow standard customer incident support process, ensure timely investigation, proper communication with customer, proper documentation in ServicewNow incident, and resolution of issues within standard SLA based on criticality of the customer incident. Create necessary JIRA issue for tracking, and SAP Note to provide resolution and fixes.

Maintain communication and documentation in English

Maintain proper communication and notification with lead ABAP developer and SAP development manager on vacation or absence to ensure minimum impact to development timeline

What can you expect from us?


• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.


What do we offer?


TCS Benefits – Brazil:

Health insurance

Dental Plan

Life insurance

Transportation vouchers

Meal/Food Voucher

Childcare assistance

Gympass

TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates

Partnership with SESC

Reimbursement of Certifications

Free TCS Learning Portal – Online courses and live training

International experience opportunity

Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools

Bring Your Buddy – By referring people you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire

TCS Gems – Recognition for performance

Xcelerate – Free Mentoring Career Platform


At TATA Consultancy Services we promote an inclusive culture, we always work for equity. This applies to Gender, People with Disabilities, LGBTQIA+, Religion, Race, Ethnicity. All our opportunities are based on these principles. We think of different actions of inclusion and social responsibility, in order to build a TCS that respects individuality. Come to be a TCSer!


#Buildingonbelief

title: Clinical Site Manager
description:
Clinical Site Manager – (Ophthalmology & Neurology Focus)

Location: Remote-based


We’re partnering with a global biopharmaceutical company dedicated to advancing treatments in Ophthalmology, Neurology , and other complex therapeutic areas. To support several ongoing and upcoming studies, we are seeking a Clinical Site Manager to oversee key investigator sites across LATAM .

This position is offering a unique opportunity to blend operational oversight with strong relationship management at the site level.


Key Responsibilities

  • Serve as the primary sponsor contact for assigned sites and CRO monitors, ensuring high-quality communication and collaboration.
  • Oversee site management activities across multiple studies, including start-up, monitoring, and close-out phases.
  • Drive patient recruitment and retention initiatives, fostering engagement with Principal Investigators and site coordinators.
  • Provide operational oversight of CRO CRAs to ensure adherence to protocol, timelines, and quality standards.
  • Support the sponsor’s clinical operations alignment , ensuring consistency and excellence in study execution.
  • Troubleshoot operational challenges and proactively address site-level issues to maintain study momentum.
  • Ensure proper management of study supplies, documentation, and compliance with GCP and sponsor SOPs.


Requirements

  • Proven experience as a Lead CRA , Senior CRA , or Clinical Site Manager with strong independent monitoring and site leadership skills.
  • Therapeutic experience in Ophthalmology and/or Neurology is essential.
  • Additional experience in Immunology, Rare Diseases, or Respiratory indications would be advantageous.
  • Solid understanding of GCP , ICH Guidelines , and regional regulatory requirements across Eastern Europe.
  • Excellent communication, relationship management, and problem-solving skills.
  • Willingness to travel across assigned countries as required.


Why Join?

  • Play a pivotal role in advancing innovative treatments that make a meaningful difference to patients’ lives.
  • Work in a hands-on, strategic role bridging sponsor oversight and site engagement.
  • Join an international, science-driven environment with opportunities for professional growth.

Planet Pharma is an American parented Employment Business/Agency that provides global staffing services with its head-quarters in Chicago and our EMEA regional office located in Central London. Our specialist knowledge and close relationships with our clients and the wider industry really makes us unique in our field. Just recently we were recognised by FORBES as the 17th best professional staffing firm, and have won multiple awards from industry accredited bodies for our commitment to excellence and service delivery. We have extensive functional expertise including: Regulatory Affairs, Pharmacovigilance, QA, QC, Submissions experts, Clinical development, Quality, Biostatistics, and Medical Affairs / Writing.


We are an equal opportunities Recruitment Business and Agency. We welcome applications from all suitably qualified candidates regardless of their race, sex, disability, religion/belief, sexual orientation or age.

title: Desenvolvedor(a) Mobile
description:
A TribeMD Assist busca um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Mobile proativo(a) e talentoso(a) para atuar no desenvolvimento e manutenção de seu aplicativo, com foco em experiência fluida, segura e de alta performance para médicos e pacientes. A vaga é para trabalho presencial em Lajeado (RS) ou remoto.


Principais responsabilidades:


  • Desenvolver e manter funcionalidades para iOS e Android.
  • Otimizar desempenho, corrigir bugs e garantir estabilidade.
  • Colaborar com designers UX/UI e equipe de back-end.
  • Garantir qualidade do código com boas práticas, testes e code reviews.
  • Gerenciar publicações nas lojas (App Store e Google Play).
  • Participar ativamente das cerimônias ágeis. 


Requisitos obrigatórios:


  • Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento mobile.
  • Proficiência em React Native, Flutter ou nativo (Swift/Kotlin).
  • Conhecimento em APIs RESTful, JSON, gerenciamento de estado e Git.
  • Familiaridade com publicação em iOS/Android.
  • Boa comunicação e trabalho em equipe. 


Diferenciais:


  • Testes automatizados, CI/CD, integração de módulos nativos.
  • Experiência com metodologias ágeis ou no setor de saúde (Health Tech).


Benefícios:


  • Salário competitivo.
  • Ambiente inovador, colaborativo e com foco em autonomia.
  • Oportunidades de crescimento profissional.


Ideal para quem é apaixonado por mobile e quer impactar positivamente a saúde digital.

title: Business Developer PtX
description:
Leap29 are partnering with a leading international Independent Power Producer (IPP) entering Brazil’s renewable energy market. They are seeking a Business Developer to drive growth in Power-to-X (PtX) and green hydrogen projects. This is a remote role, but candidates must have a strong understanding of the Brazilian market, with established networks and local expertise to identify and develop new opportunities.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Conduct market, regulatory, and economic research to identify viable PtX and green hydrogen opportunities in Brazil.
  • Evaluate potential projects, sites, and partners during the screening phase.
  • Support early-stage project risk assessment and feasibility analysis.
  • Develop preliminary financial forecasts and investment models to guide strategic decisions.
  • Collaborate with internal and external teams to assess alignment with company goals.
  • Leverage existing networks to gather market intelligence and insights.


Key Requirements:

  • Proven experience in business development for PtX, green hydrogen or related derivatives.
  • Good knowledge of PtX, green hydrogen, and renewable energy markets in Brazil.
  • Demonstrated ability to develop and maintain relationships with local stakeholders in Brazil.
  • Ability to evaluate opportunities and conduct early-stage project analysis.
  • Strategic thinker with a proactive approach to identifying business opportunities.
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English (Spanish would be a plus)
  • Able to work remotely from Brazil, with occasional travel as needed.


Join a leading European IPP expanding into Brazil’s green hydrogen and PtX market. Leverage your local expertise, work with an international team, and help shape the future of renewable energy.


Ready to take on the challenge? Apply today!

AdMaxTech is a leading mobile app user acquisition agency, working directly with top-tier advertisers across various app verticals. Our team brings together expertise from global tech giants and world-class performance marketing agencies.


Why Join Us:

  • Enjoy the flexibility of working remotely from your preferred location.
  • Be part of a fast-paced, results-driven environment in the booming mobile advertising industry.
  • The global mobile advertising market exceeded $280 billion in 2022 and is projected to reach $353 billion by 2025 — a 26% growth opportunity you can be part of.
  • Join a diverse, international team with a strong focus on collaboration, growth, and performance.


Your Role:

As a Business Development Manager, you will play a crucial role in expanding our advertiser partnerships and driving revenue growth. Your main responsibilities include:

✔ Research and identify the right decision-makers within potential advertiser organizations.

✔ Conduct pitch meetings and negotiations with prospective clients, aiming to close new deals.

✔ Collaborate closely with our internal teams to ensure a smooth onboarding process for new clients.

✔ Maintain up-to-date records and follow-up activities in our internal tracking system.


What We’re Looking For:

  • Strong research and communication skills.
  • Proven experience in business development, sales, or

title: Cloud Native Developer
description:
QAT Global, a US-based IT consulting firm with over 30 years of experience, is looking for a Senior Cloud Native Developer to join our growing team. We are proud to deliver world-class technology solutions with teams across the US, Costa Rica, and Brazil.

This is a full-time, remote position (CLT hire in Brazil only), offering the opportunity to collaborate directly with our US-based client and international development teams.


About the role:


As a Senior Cloud Native Developer , you will play a key role in designing, building, and maintaining scalable, cloud-native applications using Azure and .NET technologies . You will collaborate with product owners, architects, and cross-functional teams to implement high-quality software solutions that follow modern engineering practices.

This role is ideal for someone with deep technical expertise in Azure cloud services , microservices , and backend development , combined with strong problem-solving abilities and a collaborative mindset.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
Ascendion is a full-service digital engineering solutions company. We make and manage software platforms and products that power growth and deliver captivating experiences to consumers and employees. Our engineering, cloud, data, experience design, and talent solution capabilities accelerate transformation and impact for enterprise clients. Headquartered in New Jersey, our workforce of 6,000+ Ascenders delivers solutions from around the globe. Ascendion is built differently to engineer the next.

Ascendion | Engineering to elevate life

We have a culture built on opportunity, inclusion, and a spirit of partnership. Come, change the world with us:

  • Build the coolest tech for world’s leading brands
  • Solve complex problems – and learn new skills
  • Experience the power of transforming digital engineering for Fortune 500 clients
  • Master your craft with leading training programs and hands-on experience

Experience a community of change makers!

Join a culture of high-performing innovators with endless ideas and a passion for tech. Our culture is the fabric of our company, and it is what makes us unique and diverse. The way we share ideas, learning, experiences, successes, and joy allows everyone to be their best at Ascendion.

About the Role:


  • Role: Full Stack Engineer
  • Location: Brazil (Remote)
  • Employment Type: Contract
  • Skill : Python and Angular with AWS


What You’ll Do

  • Develop and maintain backend services in Python and frontend features in Angular .
  • Design and implement RESTful APIs , integrate with NoSQL databases , and ensure efficient data flow.
  • Deploy, test, and monitor features on AWS cloud infrastructure.
  • Collaborate within a 6-person Agile team to deliver high-quality, production-ready code.
  • Participate in code reviews, CI/CD workflows, and cloud container deployments.


Tech Stack & Requirements

  • Backend
  • Python (advanced) – core focus for API and service development.
  • Exposure to AI integrations in Python systems.
  • AWS Cloud – DynamoDB and containerized environments (Docker, ECS, EKS).
  • NoSQL Databases – MongoDB or equivalent.
  • Search – Elasticsearch / OpenSearch / Solr.
  • Java 11 (basic knowledge) – secondary backend language.
  • Frontend
  • Angular (TypeScript, HTML, CSS) – ability to build interactive web UIs.
  • Tools
  • GitHub and Jenkins for version control and CI/CD.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Sinch is looking for a talented and experienced Senior Data Engineer to join our Data Engineering team. In this crucial role, you will be responsible for building, maintaining, and supporting data pipelines that connect our various products globally. You will use innovative approaches and technologies, designing data architectures that empower the data domain and provide actionable insights that support key decisions across the organization.

Sinch is a global customer engagement platform that provides communication services for businesses across messaging, voice, and email. Sinch's services are used by more than 150,000 businesses, including many of the world's largest tech companies.


Responsibilities

  • Design and implement robust, scalable data pipelines that ensure data accuracy and availability across multiple platforms.
  • Work on the data integration of various Sinch platforms and products worldwide.
  • Contribute to data pipelines development, performance, quality, monitoring, and maintenance.
  • Optimize existing data workflows and databases for performance and scalability, using best practices and cutting-edge tools.
  • Identify opportunities for improvement in our products, business, and architecture through the strategic use of data.
  • Lead data engineering projects , serving as a technical reference and providing guidance to team members (e.g., through code reviews).
  • Collaborate actively with data scientists, analysts, and product teams to understand data needs and deliver high-quality solutions.
  • Advocate for Data Engineering best practices both inside and outside the team.
  • Stay abreast of emerging technologies and industry trends to contribute innovative ideas to our data strategy.


Must Have

  • Consistent experience as a Data Engineer or in a related role.
  • Strong knowledge of software development (e.g., Python , Spark, Git, CI/CD, Docker).
  • Expertise in SQL to query data and build ETL/ELT processes.
  • Proficiency in designing modern data pipelines and architectures.
  • Experience working with Data Lake and Data Warehouse concepts, using best practices to structure and store big volumes of data.
  • Ability to troubleshoot and optimize data pipelines for performance and reliability.
  • Experience in data pipeline creation/orchestration tools (e.g., Airflow , Dagster ).
  • Hands-on knowledge of cloud environments (e.g., AWS or GCP ).
  • Experience using Databricks or database technologies such as Snowflake or Delta Lake .
  • Knowledge of different data architectures (e.g., Data Lake, Data Mesh, Data Fabric).
  • Fluent English for effective communication with technical and business stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively and communicate complex ideas clearly .


Nice to Have

  • Experience with real-time data processing and related tools/frameworks.
  • Experience designing and implementing new data architectures.
  • Experience using any data governance/management tool .
  • Experience using a tool (e.g., Dremio ) to create a virtualization layer .
  • Knowledge of data security best practices (encryption, access controls).
  • Ability to organize and break down complex projects/initiatives into manageable tasks.


Desired Skills and Experience

Consistent experience as a Data Engineer or in a related role.

Strong knowledge of software development (e.g., Python, Spark, Git, CI/CD, Docker).

Expertise in SQL to query data and build ETL/ELT processes.

Proficiency in designing modern data pipelines and architectures.

Experience working with Data Lake and Data Warehouse concepts, using best practices to structure and store big volumes of data.

Ability to troubleshoot and optimize data pipelines for performance and reliability.

Experience in data pipeline creation/orchestration tools (e.g., Airflow, Dagster).

Hands-on knowledge of cloud environments (e.g., AWS or GCP).

Experience using Databricks or database technologies such as Snowflake or Delta Lake.

Knowledge of different data architectures (e.g., Data Lake, Data Mesh, Data Fabric).

Fluent English for effective communication with technical and business stakeholders.

Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively and communicate complex ideas clearly.

title: Pessoa Analista de Desenvolvimento de Sistemas Sênior Full-Stack
description:
#Nosso jeito de fazer história:

Entre para a história de construção do maior Hub de Dados e Analytics do Brasil.

Além de você contribuir diretamente neste objetivo, você estará se desenvolvendo constantemente, por meio de grandes desafios de negócio, junto a um time de alto impacto. Na Neoway, acreditamos em fazer as coisas de forma inovadora, colaborativa, responsável e com foco no cliente.

Falando da área:

Trabalhar na área de Engenharia da Neoway mantém o colaborador conectado com a inovação, ao constante aprimoramento por melhores metodologias de desenvolvimento e a novas tecnologias para atender os objetivos estratégicos e de negócios da Neoway.

Utilizamos metodologias ágeis por princípio e focamos no ciclo de desenvolvimento de produto para oferecer a melhor experiência aos nossos usuários. O time de Engenharia é responsável por construir, evoluir e sustentar todo o ecossistema que compõem nossa plataforma de Big Data Analytics, chamada Plataforma Neoway.


Acreditamos que um software de qualidade é fácil de usar, funciona corretamente, é de fácil manutenção/sustentação, fácil integração e mantém a integridade para evitar possíveis falhas, fora ou não, do controle de quem o desenvolveu.


Para alcançar este objetivo atuamos em dois pilares distintos para garantir a eficiência do processo de desenvolvimento de software assegurando a qualidade junto a um ambiente saudável na área de Engenharia, no aspecto de boas práticas e cultura de desenvolvimento:


1° - Pessoas é um pilar estratégico para Neoway, atuamos de maneira pró ativa em conjunto com todas as áreas da empresa, garantindo o desenvolvimento de talentos, crescimento profissional e formação do nosso DNA, impulsionando a cultura de times de alta performance (liberdade com responsabilidade).


2° - Técnico (Paved Way), acreditamos que ferramental e a automação ajudam a dimensionar a capacidade de um time, mas nenhuma ferramenta resolverá todos os problemas na produtividade no desenvolvimento ou nas operações. A ideia é ter um conjunto de ferramentas e práticas de “paved way” que são formalmente suportadas por algumas pessoas. Não exigimos a adoção desses “paved way” , mas incentivamos a adoção, garantindo que o desenvolvimento e as operações usando essas tecnologias sejam uma experiência muito melhor do que não usá-las.


Falando do time:

O foco do time é contribuir para a evolução estratégica da Plataforma Neoway, fornecendo às Unidades de Negócio da empresa uma série de sistemas, ferramentas e padrões que apoiam e promovem a autonomia dos demais times de desenvolvimento a acelerar suas entregas e criação de novos produtos.

Missão do cargo:

Como Pessoa Desenvolvedora de Software você fará parte de um dos times de desenvolvimento e será responsável por agregar conhecimento técnico ao time, sustentando, evoluindo ou construindo parte das soluções de nossa plataforma, garantindo a segurança, buscando soluções para situações do dia a dia, visando sempre o trabalho harmônico em equipe, a qualidade do código e da arquitetura em geral.


Como será o seu dia a dia no time:

  • Trabalhar na concepção de soluções técnicas, na quebra de tarefas, planejamento e na execução das demandas;
  • Garantir a qualidade das entregas, fomentando práticas de Code Review e desenvolvimento orientado a testes (TDD/BDD);
  • Manter, monitorar e garantir a eficiência dos serviços construídos e de responsabilidade do seu time;
  • Participar das dinâmicas de trabalho adotadas pelo time;
  • Trabalhar de forma colaborativa no processo de melhoria contínua do seu time;
  • Colaborar nas definições de arquitetura, escalabilidade e segurança dos nossos produtos;
  • Criar soluções com base em uma arquitetura distribuída e de microserviços;
  • Criar soluções resilientes, escaláveis e de alta performance;
  • Garantir desenvolvimento seguro, observando atualizações de segurança e critérios relevantes;
  • Atuar como referência técnica no time, apoiando colegas menos experientes e disseminando boas práticas.


Para assumir estas responsabilidades você precisa ter as seguintes habilidades:

  • Compreensão de arquiteturas distribuídas e de alto volume de dados (repositórios, filas, microsserviços, etc);
  • Domínio de conceitos e boas práticas de engenharia de software (da concepção à entrega, sustentação e operação, TDD, documentação, code review, etc);
  • Experiência em Go ou Node.js, com abertura para aprender outras stacks;
  • Experiência com bancos relacionais e não relacionais (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, etc);
  • Experiência com infraestrutura em Cloud (preferencialmente GCP);
  • Conhecimentos em APIs Rest, Docker e Kubernetes;
  • Programação concorrente e escalável;
  • Conhecimento em processos de versionamento e práticas de CI/CD;
  • Experiência com observabilidade (monitoramento, logging, tracing, métricas);
  • Boa comunicação e colaboração em equipe;
  • Capacidade de encarar mudanças como oportunidades e aprender com erros;
  • Facilidade em compartilhar conhecimento e atuar como mentor(a);
  • Promover nossa cultura e valores.


Alguns diferenciais que estamos de olho. Mas não se preocupe caso não tenha, ajudamos você nessa parte:

  • Conhecimento dos conceitos de Big Data, Data Lake, Metadados com perspectiva de governança de dados;
  • Experiência com front-end moderno (Vue.js, Angular, React);
  • Conhecimento de infraestrutura como código (Terraform, Ansible);
  • Conhecimento em serviços de mensageria (PubSub, SNS, Kafka);
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de análise e busca (BigQuery, ElasticSearch).


#NeoJourney l Cardápio de Benefícios:

Vale Alimentação/Refeição;

Utilizamos metodologias ágeis por princípio e focamos no ciclo de desenvolvimento de produto para oferecer a melhor experiência aos nossos usuários. title: UX Wordpress Elementor / Digital Display Ad & Video Ad / Mobile App Designers
description:
Please only apply if you are really a 'full stack' designer with a variety of seasoned skills incluidng design Elementor Wordpress AND digital display ads that are graphic intensive AND ad video shorts PLUS Bonus for Mobile App design.


Are you a dedicated, resourceful team player with strong creative skills and a portfolio of work which demonstrates passion for UX design with skills ranging from Wordpress Elementor sites & landing pages to ad sets to ad video shorts to mobile app design? Do you have experience working with numerous different design platforms especially in digital form, especially Adobe Creative Suite? Have you made eye-catching animated digital ads? Have you made social media video ads with AI characters like HeyGen and searched for stock video and audio footage based on the sales scripts?


Portfolio of web and digital ad design REQUIRED to be considered for the position.


About Us

Life Water Media specializes in digital branding and awareness campaigns for publicly traded companies and other large scale projects. We started in 2019.


Responsibilities

  • Handle multiple graphic projects from start to finish, adhering to set deadlines set by Creative Director.
  • Create UX landing pages on Wordpress with Elementor with provided copy and details set by Creative Director.
  • Create eye-catching display ads with animation on creatopy.com that stimulate visitors from Facebook, Google, etc
  • Create multiple variations of compelling, memorable logos, custom web graphics, web page designs, and digital media ads that reflect critical thinking and design excellence.
  • Stylize the copy provided from our writers into a custom Wordpress page so that it's aesthetically pleasing, professional, unique.
  • Review success of ads and suggest updates and new ads styles.
  • Create Web design layouts, company presentations, brochure, investor decks, infographics, and PowerPoint presentations.
  • Strong knowledge of UX design for websites, native and social apps
  • Open to using additional apps such as midjourney.com (unique ai images), creatopy.com (for automated ad sizing), (additional landing page platform, similar to Elementor), capcut, etc.
  • Able to make TikTok and Youtube ad video shorts based on sales scripts with stock video and audio
  • Able to make mobile app designs on Figma


Qualifications

  • Proficient in Adobe Creative Suite
  • Strong communication, conceptual thinking, typography skills and design skills
  • HTML/CSS design
  • Deadline and detail-oriented
  • Self Starter who can be self-taught and work without much direction
  • Works well in collaboration with a team and independently.
  • Must have excellent grammar skills
  • Must have the ability to multitask, work in a busy environment just as good as in solitude. This position requires a personality that can accept constructive criticism, change directions rapidly and accept new assignments frequently with pressing deadlines.


Compensation

Salary: based on your experience level

Bonuses: Performance and team share bonuses


To Apply Submit:

  • Current resume
  • Synopsis of recent salary history
  • Portfolio of your digital media work ranging from ads to web pages.


Requirements Before Employment

  • Short paid test project showcasing landing page, video and digital ads to assess work quality with our spec
  • Signed Independent Contractor Agreement and w8-Ben (USA tax form for International)


Company Culture

  • Remote
  • We're playful, tight nit, friendly, family-oriented atmosphere.
company: TD Media LLC (dba Life Water Media)

title: SDR | EXECUTIVO DE VENDAS | JÚNIOR
description:
Na Klooks, transformamos informações financeiras difíceis de acessar em dados claros, organizados e prontos para serem usados em decisões importantes. É por isso que algumas das maiores empresas do mundo, como Bloomberg, S&P e Moody’s, já confiam em nós. No Brasil, bancos como Itaú e Santander também utilizam nossos serviços, assim como centenas de consultorias que acessam todos os dias nossa plataforma.


Agora queremos escalar esse serviço — e precisamos de você para fazer parte dessa jornada.


Se você gosta de vendas consultivas, tem interesse por finanças e tecnologia, e se motiva em entender os desafios dos clientes para fechar negócios estratégicos, esse é o lugar certo para você crescer.


Perfil desejado – o que esperamos de você


Buscamos um(a) profissional com perfil consultivo e analítico , que saiba

construir relações de confiança com os clientes e conduzir negociações de forma estratégica. É essencial ter escuta ativa, curiosidade para entender diferentes modelos de negócio e habilidade para traduzir dados e soluções técnicas em benefícios claros para o cliente.


Skills e competências que valorizamos

  • Experiência em vendas B2B , especialmente com ciclos consultivos e soluções complexas (SaaS, dados, tecnologia ou serviços financeiros);
  • Conhecimento de técnicas de vendas consultivas como Spin Selling;
  • Habilidade para entender o cenário do cliente , mapear dores e propor soluções alinhadas ao valor da Klooks;
  • Capacidade de apresentar e negociar propostas comerciais com diferentes níveis de decisão.
  • Conhecimento ou interesse por indicadores financeiros , análise de balanços mercado financeiro e inteligência de dados;
  • Conhecimento em Excel/Google Planilhas e apresentações, Google Slides/PPT.
  • Cumprir a cadência de contato com os leads, realizar follow ups e acompanhar a evolução do funil de vendas;
  • Perfil orientado a metas, dados e performance;
  • Boa comunicação verbal e escrita;
  • Capacidade de organização e gestão do pipeline via CRM;


Diferenciais

  • Experiência com soluções baseadas em dados;
  • Familiaridade com demonstrações financeiras;
  • Vivência em startups, fintechs, consultorias financeiras ou empresas de tecnologia;


Oportunidade

  • CLT - Tempo integral
  • Trabalho 100% remoto
  • Fixo de R$ 3.000 + Comissão (em média R$ 500 / mês mas podendo chegar a R$ 2.000)
  • Vale alimentação
  • Wellhub (Gympass)
  • Plano de Saúde com coparticipação
  • Day Off no dia de aniversário


Gostou? Envie seu CV para com o assunto Executivo de Vendas | Closer - Klooks

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
Role: Senior Full Stack Developer (Java Spring Boot | Ruby on Rails | Angular)

Experience: 7+ years

Work location: Heredia, Costa Rica & remote for LATAM

English Required: B2+ - C1

Job Summary:

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Full Stack Developer with deep expertise in Java Spring Boot, Ruby on Rails, and Angular to lead complex application development initiatives. The ideal candidate will be a strong technical contributor with a proven track record in building scalable, high-performance systems. While excelling in backend implementation and frontend execution. This role is ideal for a technically strong developer who is ready to expand their impact beyond code delivery into collaborative leadership, stakeholder communication, and architectural decision-making.

Require Qualifications:

  • 7+ years of professional experience in Java Spring Boot and core Java (OOP, data structures, algorithms).
  • 2+ years of hands-on experience with Ruby on Rails and full-stack web development.
  • Proven experience with Angular and modern frontend technologies (HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript/TypeScript, Node.js).
  • Strong understanding of RESTful APIs, microservices architecture, and cloud-native development.
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines, Git, Docker, and deployment automation tools.
  • Effective communication across global teams.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead end-to-end development of scalable, secure, and maintainable applications using Spring Boot, Ruby on Rails, and Angular .
  • Deliver high-quality code with a strong emphasis on performance, security, and clean architecture .
  • Actively participate in code reviews, technical discussions, and architectural decisions.
  • Collaborate closely with product managers, designers, QA teams, and other team members to translate business needs into technical solutions.
  • Drive technical documentation, knowledge sharing, and standardization across teams.
  • Represent technical solutions and communicate with both technical and non-technical stakeholders, including executives.
  • Proactively identify risks and implement mitigation strategies in project planning and execution.
  • Contribute to migration projects, system modernization, and platform upgrades with minimal disruption.

title: Atlassian Consultant
description:
Company Description

At Atlas Bench, we are committed to transforming teamwork across industries through innovative Atlassian services. Our global team, proficient in DevOps and ITSM, specializes in agile methodologies and AI solutions tailored for Atlassian products. Serving over 1000 clients, including Fortune 500 companies, we are known for managed licensing, consulting, and AI-driven Atlassian integrations.   • Strong knowledge of DevOps practices and ITSM methodologies
  • Proficiency in agile methodologies and AI solutions for Atlassian tools
  • Skills in providing training and support for Atlassian tools
  • Excellent communication and consulting skills
  • Ability to work independently and remotely
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field
  • Experience with Fortune 500 clients or large-scale enterprise projects is a plus

title: Senior Data Product Analyst
description:
Job Title: Senior Data Product Analyst (Remote, US Central Time Zone Hours)

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Data Analyst to join our dynamic team. In this role, you will collaborate with the data products team to perform a variety of analytics-related tasks, including creating dashboards, building tables, and conducting in-depth data analyses. This position requires strong experience working in an Azure environment and the ability to work remotely while aligning with US Central Time Zone hours.


This role would be ideal for someone with a strong Data Engineering background who wants to be part of the Data Product team.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Partner with stakeholders to understand business needs and translate them into data-driven solutions.
  • Perform data analysis and data profiling, identifying new data sources to enhance business processes.
  • Develop, refine, and maintain dashboards, reports, and analytics products to support decision-making.
  • Conduct User Acceptance Testing (UAT), including creating test plans based on stakeholder discussions and adapting existing tests for new use cases.
  • Document processes, findings, and methodologies to ensure transparency and reusability.


Required Skills and Qualifications:

  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills to effectively engage with stakeholders.
  • Proven experience in data analysis, data profiling, and delivering analytics solutions.
  • Expertise in SQL.
  • Experience working in an Azure environment.
  • Familiarity with UAT processes, including test creation and execution.
  • Attention to detail and ability to document workflows and findings.



If you thrive in a fast-paced environment and have a passion for transforming data into actionable insights, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Sênior Gen AI Engineer - Inglês avançado/fluente
description:
Contratação PJ - valor em reais

Atuação remota

Cliente internacional - pode haver necessidade de atuar em outro fuso horário



Você é apaixonado por Inteligência Artificial Generativa e quer trabalhar com tecnologias de ponta como Langchain, RAG e LLMs? Temos uma oportunidade incrível para você!


Responsabilidades:

  • Projetar e desenvolver soluções baseadas em GenAI e LLMs com ferramentas como Langchain e pipelines RAG.
  • Aplicar técnicas de engenharia de prompts e frameworks baseados em agentes para criar soluções inteligentes e contextuais.
  • Colaborar com o time de engenharia para definir e evoluir o roadmap técnico de iniciativas com LLMs.
  • Traduzir necessidades de negócio em soluções escaláveis e prontas para produção.
  • Trabalhar em parceria com especialistas de negócio e times de dados para garantir aderência dos modelos aos casos reais.
  • Participar de discussões de arquitetura, revisões de código e otimizações de performance.


Requisitos Técnicos:

  • Domínio em Python , Langchain e SQL .
  • Conhecimento profundo sobre LLMs: tuning de prompts, embeddings, bancos vetoriais e fluxos com agentes.
  • Background sólido em engenharia de software ou machine learning com visão sistêmica.
  • Experiência com AWS , Azure ou GCP .
  • Perfil colaborativo, com autonomia e excelente comunicação.
  • Inglês avançado/fluente para conversação


Diferenciais:

  • Mínimo de 1 ano de experiência prática com LLMs e GenAI.
  • Vivência em pipelines de produtos de IA ou deploys fim a fim.
  • Familiaridade com práticas de MLOps e padrões escaláveis de deploy.
  • Experiência em projetos com clientes ou times multifuncionais de IA.

title: Especialista SAP ABAP e FIORI
description:
Who we are

At Amaris Consulting , we are an independent technology consulting firm providing guidance and solutions to businesses. We partner with more than 1,000 clients worldwide, delivering expertise across multiple sectors to drive digital transformation and innovation.

In Brazil , Amaris has grown year after year, reaching over 400 projects and collaborating with international clients from the US and Europe . Our consultants benefit from career development, ongoing training , and the flexibility to be reallocated across projects , ensuring exposure to diverse technologies and challenges.

We stand out for how we care about our people — through regular follow-ups, human-centered management, and a strong focus on professional growth.


Job description

We are looking for a SAP ABAP Developer to join our remote team and support international projects. The ideal candidate will have strong technical experience in SAP development tools and the ability to communicate fluently in English while collaborating with global teams.


Your missions

  • Develop, maintain, and enhance SAP applications using ABAP.
  • Design and implement solutions using: Fiori, IDOCs, APIs, SmartForms , SAPscript , and Adobe Forms
  • Build and optimize Reports , Dynamic Developments , Excel Creations , and ALV Reports .
  • Develop and maintain Methods and Classes in line with project standards.
  • Collaborate with functional teams to translate business requirements into efficient technical solutions.
  • Ensure high-quality code and performance through testing and documentation.


Your profile

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field.
  • Proven experience as a SAP ABAP Developer .
  • Fluent English (mandatory) — written and spoken.
  • Strong analytical skills and ability to work independently in a remote setup.


Strong knowledge of:

  • Fiori , IDOCs , APIs , SmartForms , SAPscript , Adobe Forms , Reports , ALV , and OO ABAP .
  • Good understanding of SAP modules and integration processes.



What we offer

  • International exposure with clients in Europe and the US .
  • A human-centered culture focused on career growth and development.
  • Access to training programs and mentoring opportunities through Amaris Academy.
  • Flexibility to work remotely with a dynamic and multicultural team.

title: Senior Counsel
description:
Our Senior Counsel will be responsible for leading client correspondence and managing client relationships. We value organized, collegial and highly motivated individuals with a client-centered approach to legal representation. This position is ideal for an entrepreneurial attorney who possesses strong leadership and communication skills and who thrives in a dynamic environment. The Senior Counsel will help shape our legal services, counseling our clients with clear and concise contract drafting, communicating with clients’ internal and external stakeholders, leading complex commercial negotiations, and providing counsel on general risk management. This role is for someone who is committed to offering best-in-class legal services and has a desire to be a proactive strategic partner.


Responsibilities

  • Lead the negotiation of SaaS agreements for clients negotiating with Fortune 500 customers, and identify, coordinate and resolve issues for subject matter expert review
  • Support clients’ business units with structuring and negotiating a variety of transactions relating to product commercialization and corporate development, including early-stage investments, joint ventures, and mergers and acquisitions
  • Provide general counsel and partner with third party subject matter experts to efficiently lead a comprehensive legal strategy
  • Assist with corporate governance processes including managing internal corporate actions, charters, bylaws, and board meeting materials
  • Collaborate with the Managing Counsel on business development activities to drive firm growth
  • Operate with limited supervision, demonstrate sound judgment and an ability to independently and effectively manage priorities, and proactively identify when to escalate issues with internal and client stakeholders


Qualifications

  • JD from a top tier law school and excellent academic credentials
  • Admission to the state bar where the candidate resides
  • 6+ years of experience at a law firm (AmLaw 100 preferred), in-house, or preferably both
  • Ability to deliver polished work product and effectively collaborate with clients and negotiate with third parties
  • Strong drafting skills and the ability to identify, incorporate and improve client-preferred terms
  • Commitment to integrity, excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to lead with empathy
  • Strong project management skills and the ability to coordinate multiple matters simultaneously
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills and high attention to detail


We offer:

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule
  • Personal laptop
  • Health/Sport Budget
  • Fully remote

title: Technical Services Manager (SAP ECS)
description:
About HCLTech


HCLTech is a global technology company, spread across 60 countries, delivering industry-leading capabilities centered around digital, engineering, cloud and AI, powered by a broad portfolio of technology services and products. We work with clients across all major verticals, providing industry solutions for Financial Services, Manufacturing, Life Sciences and Healthcare, Technology and Services, Telecom and Media, Retail and CPG, and Public Services. We re powered by our people a global, diverse, multi-generational talent - representing 161 nationalities whose unique spark, perspective and boundless passion drive our culture of proactive value creation and problem-solving.


To learn more about how we can supercharge progress for you, visit


Your role and responsabilities:


  • Be the primary technical contact for customers, guiding them through their SAP journey.
  • Lead technical discussions , manage escalations, and ensure seamless delivery of ECS services.
  • Support SAP S/4HANA conversions , migrations, and upgrades with deep technical expertise.
  • Collaborate with Client Delivery Managers, Product Leads, and Architects to shape long-term service plans.
  • Drive innovation adoption , capacity planning, and landscape optimization.
  • Provide hands-on support during critical cutovers and IT situations


Requirements and Qualifications:


  • Experience in SAP Basis & infrastructure
  • Hands-on experience in SAP Migration and/or Upgrade projects.
  • Knowledge of Hyperscalers (Azure, AWS, GCP).
  • Experience with SAP RISE Migration and Enterprise Cloud Services is a plus.
  • Certifications in SAP Migration or Upgrade (ZDO method) are highly valued.
  • Willingness to support weekend cutovers when needed.
  • Expertise in SAP NetWeaver , high availability/disaster recovery architecture.
  • Familiarity with SAP cloud integrations (SCP, Ariba, SuccessFactors).
  • Strong problem-solving mindset with a focus on preventing downtime .
  • Advanced English .


Please, submit resumé in English.

Portanto, sua cor, religião, gênero, raça, nacionalidade, idade, origem, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou orientação sexual não são barreiras para se juntar à nossa equipe. #VemSerFoursys! Que tal se juntar a nós e se tornar um(a) #FourTalent? Então se liga nessa oportunidade incrível:

- Desenvolvimento Full-Stack de Backend: Projetar, desenvolver e manter ativamente os novos microsserviços em Java (Spring Boot), garantindo um código limpo, eficiente e escalável.

- Java

- .NET (C#)

- Docker

- SQL

- NoSQL

title: Public Relations Manager - LATAM
description:
About Cooler Master

Cooler Master is a global computer hardware manufacturer founded in 1992 in Taiwan. The company is known for its award-winning PC components, including cases, power supplies, cooling solutions, and accessories.


In addition to retail product lines, Cooler Master also serves as an OEM partner to major technology brands worldwide. The company has grown steadily through a strong focus on innovation, design, and user-driven product development. Headquartered in Taipei, Cooler Master operates manufacturing facilities in China and maintains regional offices across the globe.


Role Overview

Lead public relations for Latin America (LATAM) to elevate Cooler Master’s visibility across key markets such as Brazil, Mexico, Argentina, and Chile.

You’ll manage PR execution for launches and ongoing brand activations—aligning local media, translating technical information into engaging stories, and ensuring consistent communication with global and regional marketing teams.


Key Responsibilities

  • Own the LATAM PR Plan – Develop and execute the regional PR calendar and embargo plan; ensure alignment with global launches and LATAM sales priorities.
  • Build Media Relationships – Cultivate strong connections with top-tier tech and gaming editors, reviewers, and influencers across Portuguese and Spanish-speaking markets.
  • Host Press Briefings & Events – Lead virtual and local events; manage press lists, invitations, materials, and post-event follow-ups.
  • Coordinate Product Reviews – Manage the sample allocation, delivery, and follow-up process with regional media outlets.
  • Partner Collaboration – Drive joint PR opportunities with distributors, e-commerce partners, and brand collaborators.
  • Content Localization – Adapt global press materials for LATAM audiences to ensure cultural and linguistic accuracy.
  • Monitor & Report – Track press coverage, analyze media performance metrics, and deliver post-launch summaries.
  • Maintain Compliance – Ensure consistent application of embargoes, NDA terms, and authorized content usage.


Qualifications

  • Education : Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Communications, Journalism, Marketing, or related field.
  • Experience : 5–8+ years in tech, consumer electronics, or gaming PR across LATAM. Proven track record in media relations and launch management.
  • Regional Expertise :
  • Strong understanding of LATAM media ecosystem and regional communication styles.
  • Existing relationships with major tech and gaming outlets.
  • Language Skills :
  • Fluent in English and either Portuguese or Spanish (bilingual proficiency preferred).
  • Execution & Measurement :
  • Strong organizational skills, ability to manage multiple launches.
  • Familiarity with PR metrics such as share of voice and media reach.


Who You Are

  • A proactive communicator with high accountability and attention to detail.
  • Skilled at relationship-building across diverse markets and cultures.
  • Confident managing embargoes, timelines, and media expectations.
  • Adaptable and independent, yet collaborative with global teammates.

title: Desenvolvedor Java Pleno
description:
Work at Exadel - Who We Are:

Since 1998, Exadel has been engineering its products and custom software for clients of all sizes. Headquartered in Walnut Creek, California, Exadel has 2,800+ employees in development centers across America, Europe, and Asia. People drive Exadel’s success and are at the core of our values.



*Responsibilities*

Design and implement prioritized backend features using best software engineering practices and consistent functional and technical validations throughout the development lifecycle.

Deliver scalable, flexible, and resilient solutions aligned with modern architectural principles.

Apply and advocate for architectural patterns such as event-driven microservices.

Actively participate in technical discussions and contribute to the evolution of the product’s technical architecture.

Support product discussions by providing technical input to guide architecture-related decisions.

Integrate internal and external services using RESTful APIs, asynchronous messaging, and event hubs.


*Requirements:

  • Experience in backend development with Java 8+
  • Experience with Spring Boot
  • Strong experience in developing and deploying microservices in public cloud environments (preferably AWS).
  • Solid knowledge of relational (e.g., MySQL, PostgreSQL) and non-relational databases (e.g., DynamoDB, MongoDB).
  • Experience with messaging and event streaming systems (e.g., Kafka, RabbitMQ, SQS, SNS).
  • Proficiency with microservices architecture including containerization (Docker) and orchestration (Kubernetes).
  • Familiarity with observability best practices (structured logging, metrics, health checks), using tools like DataDog.
  • Strong testing practices: unit testing (JUnit), integration and contract testing (Postman/Newman).
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines using tools like Jenkins or similar.

title: Engenheiro(a) De Software Backend Pleno - Ruby on Rails
description:
O Grupo Smart Fit é muito mais do que a maior rede de academias da América Latina e o maior empregador de profissionais de educação física do mundo. Somos um verdadeiro ecossistema focado em bem-estar e saúde, impactando a vida de milhares de pessoas todos os dias.


Estamos em mais de 15 países, com mais de 1.800 unidades, e temos o prazer de atender mais de 5,2 milhões de alunos. Nossa equipe de 15 mil colaboradores está sempre a mil, trazendo novas ideias e inovações. Desde que abrimos nossa capital em 2021, aceleramos nossa missão de transformar vidas com soluções de fitness e saúde.


Temos várias marcas no nosso portfólio, como Bio Ritmo, Smart Fit, Race Bootcamp, Vidya Studio, Jab House, Tonus Gym, One Pilates, Velocity, Kore TotalPass e Nation CT. Além disso, oferecemos produtos digitais como Queima Diária, Smart Fit Nutri e Smart Fit Coach. Estamos sempre procurando novas formas de integrar tecnologia e inovação para ajudar você a ter um estilo de vida mais ativo e saudável. E aí, topa o desafio junto com a gente?


O que nos move todos os dias?

Somos parte da mudança, transformando o cenário e trazendo mais qualidade para a vida de quem tá junto com a gente. Cada gotinha de suor é uma prova do nosso compromisso em inspirar e motivar todo mundo que quer uma vida mais ativa e saudável. A cada dia, começamos nossa jornada com aquecimento total, prontos para alcançar novos objetivos e viver o máximo.


O(A) Engenheiro(a) De Software Backend Pleno - Ruby será responsável por:

Implementação de Soluções

  • Escrever e implementar código conforme requisitos.
  • Garantir qualidade e usabilidade do produto.
  • Testar e depurar em diferentes ambientes.
  • Contribuir em decisões de arquitetura e design.
  • Revisar código para manter padrões de qualidade.
  • Integrar componentes de software.
  • Estimar tarefas junto ao Líder Técnico e PM, utilizando métricas da equipe.


Sustentação dos Sistemas

  • Resolver chamados (erros e dúvidas).
  • Executar scripts e relatórios de apoio.
  • Garantir segurança e privacidade dos dados com apoio e revisão dos líderes e pares.
  • Participar de war rooms com TL e/ou PM.
  • Atuar pela estabilidade do sistema com SRE e TL, respondendo a alertas e prevenindo falhas.


Itens essenciais que não podem faltar no seu kit:

  • 3 a 5 anos de experiência comprovada em desenvolvimento backend com Ruby on Rails em ambiente de produção.
  • Vivência em arquitetura de sistemas web escaláveis, considerando boas práticas de design, organização de código e manutenção de projetos de longo prazo.
  • Conhecimento sólido em modelagem de dados relacionais e otimização de queries SQL, especialmente em bancos como PostgreSQL ou MySQL.
  • Proficiência em ActiveRecord, ActionCable, ActionMailer e background jobs.
  • Experiência com performance tuning e estratégias para alta escalabilidade.
  • Práticas de testes automatizados (RSpec, Minitest, FactoryBot, etc.).


Infraestrutura e DevOps:

  • Experiência com Docker para containerização de aplicações.
  • Vivência em AWS com serviços como ECS, RDS, S3, CloudWatch, ElasticSearch e Redis.
  • Conhecimento de CI/CD (preferencialmente GitHub Actions, GitLab CI ou similares).


Monitoramento e Observabilidade:

  • Capacidade de configurar e interpretar métricas de APM e erros.
  • Experiência com ferramentas como New Relic, Datadog, Sentry ou similares.


Integrações e Comunicação entre Sistemas:

  • Experiência com serviços de mensageria (RabbitMQ, Kafka, SQS, Sidekiq ou similares).
  • Boas práticas em comunicação entre sistemas distribuídos (eventos assíncronos, retries, idempotência).
  • Experiência em background jobs, com foco em throughput, concorrência e resiliência.


Performance e Boas Práticas:

  • Experiência em otimização de aplicações web (tempo de resposta, uso de cache, indexação de banco).
  • Domínio em boas práticas de programação (Clean Code, SOLID, design patterns).
  • Conhecimentos de segurança de aplicações web (OWASP Top 10, autenticação, criptografia).


Desejável :

  • Experiência em integração com gateways de pagamento (ex: Stripe, Adyen, Pagar.me, Cielo, Stone, etc.).
  • Conhecimento de protocolos de autenticação e segurança (OAuth2, JWT, TLS, assinatura de mensagens).
  • Vivência com conciliação de transações financeiras e tratamento de falhas em fluxos críticos (reprocessamento seguro, antifraude, consistência de dados).


Cuidados com a nossa gente:

Mantemos um ambiente descontraído, onde cada ideia conta. Na base da colaboração e criatividade, a gente está sempre evoluindo e de olho nas tendências que movem o mundo fitness


Aqui é tudo sobre o "porquê" fazemos o que fazemos. Apesar de sermos o maior Grupo de academias da América Latina, sabemos que a saúde e o bem-estar devem ser integral.

title: Consultor(a) SAP SD Sênior
description:
Consultor(a) SAP SD Sênior

Brasil - Modelo de trabalho: Remoto


Sobre a Motivus

Na Motivus, acreditamos em liberar o potencial humano por meio de soluções inovadoras e de ponta. Com mais de 1.600 colaboradores em 5 países, oferecemos um amplo espectro de serviços de software e soluções digitais. Nossas equipes são dedicadas a impulsionar a sustentabilidade, expandir os limites da tecnologia e construir a próxima geração de soluções digitais de classe mundial que capacitam nossos clientes e geram impacto duradouro. Ao se juntar à nossa equipe, você trabalhará com profissionais visionários comprometidos em criar soluções inovadoras que moldam o futuro da indústria.


Visão Geral da Posição

Estamos em busca de um profissional sênior com forte atuação consultiva e experiência em projetos de implementação e rollout SAP SD, capaz de traduzir necessidades de negócio em soluções eficientes, mantendo sinergia com times multifuncionais e práticas globais.


Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Conduzir levantamento de requisitos e desenho de soluções funcionais;
  • Realizar parametrização, testes e suporte pós-go-live;
  • Garantir alinhamento entre áreas de negócio e TI, atuando de forma colaborativa;
  • Apoiar projetos S/4HANA, integrações e melhorias contínuas


Qualificações:

  • SAP SD completo (vendas, faturamento, pricing, shipping, impostos);
  • Experiência em projetos end-to-end e metodologias ágeis;
  • Desejável vivência com S/4HANA.
  • Conhecimentos básicos de debbug, já que é um sênior precisamos deste perfil para aprofundar em analise. Porque no projeto tenho time de abap.


Requisitos :

  • +5 anos de experiência como Consultor SAP SD;
  • Participação em implementações completas;
  • Perfil colaborativo, ágil e orientado a resultados;
  • Inglês avançado
  • Espanhol (Diferencial)


Por Que Se Juntar a Nós?

  • Desenvolva sua Carreira : Na Motivus, você terá a oportunidade de expandir suas habilidades e assumir cargos de liderança em projetos diversificados.

title: Senior Software Engineer (Golang)
description:
We are seeking a remote, full-time Senior Software Engineer with 8 to 12 years of software programming experience, including a strong background in Golang, Kubernetes, major cloud platforms, and CI/CD. You will fully automate provisioning, deployment, management, and monitoring for a rapidly evolving and highly scalable set of SaaS services. You will work with members of the DevOps team alongside a DevOps architect to ensure best practices are implemented across applications, lead teams in the direction of initiatives, such as CI/CD and enterprise monitoring, and work on support services operational on the cloud.

You are the ideal candidate if you enjoy improving engineering efficiency, mentoring junior team members, promoting best practices, and solving problems by digging into the technical details.

Our client was named a Top 25 Cybersecurity Company by The Software Report and one of Inc. Magazine's Best Places to Work in 2020. The company is a leader in cloud-based networking and security services. Their services empower organizations to optimize cloud usage, delivering network experiences that are simple, scalable, and reliable. The client counts 70% of the Fortune 500 companies as customers.


Responsibilities

  • Develop, design, and maintain features that empower developer productivity
  • Design and implement components of the client's next-generation, internal developer platform
  • Recommend ways to improve system reliability, efficiency, and quality
  • Work closely with various cross-functional product teams
  • Stay up-to-date on key trends, especially in the area of technologies and frameworks like Kubernetes, Docker, ELK/Prometheus, and more
  • Own platform engineering
  • Develop REST APIs and contribute to the overall API framework
  • Use multiple open software to build a developer platform


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 8 to 12 years of experience in software development using programming languages
  • Experience with Golang, including building API and web services
  • Experience with DevOps technologies and methodologies, including Kubernetes, major cloud platforms (preferably AWS), and CI/CD
  • Solid understanding of microservices architecture and container-based software, such as Docker
  • Experience developing microservices and using Cloud Services API
  • Strong focus on reliability and security
  • Solid exposure to application performance tuning, memory management, and scalability
  • Ability to design highly scalable distributed systems using different open-source technologies


Desired Experience

  • University degree or equivalent educational experience (preferably in a STEM field)
  • Additional container technologies besides Docker and Kubernetes
  • Experience with Amazon Web Services, such as EC2, VPC, ELB, S3, and CloudFormation, or equivalent services in GCP and/or Azure


Additional Info

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture, share knowledge, be inclusive, learn, and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter – think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let’s learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual – no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP

title: Desenvolvedor Front-End Pleno (Angular / React)
description:
Responsabilidades e Atribuições

  • Desenvolver e manter aplicações web modernas integradas a sistemas industriais e corporativos.
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com times de backend, UX/UI e QA, garantindo entregas consistentes e de qualidade.
  • Garantir performance, usabilidade e segurança nas interfaces.
  • Apoiar testes, correções e melhorias em ambiente de homologação e produção.
  • Contribuir com boas práticas, revisões de código e arquitetura front-end.


Requisitos e Qualificações

  • Experiência sólida com Angular e React (um dos dois em nível avançado).
  • Domínio de JavaScript / TypeScript, HTML5, CSS3 e REST APIs.
  • Conhecimento de Git, versionamento e pipelines de CI/CD.
  • Capacidade de compreender integrações com sistemas industriais (MES, PI System, SCADA etc.).
  • Experiencia com plataformas de padronização e qualidade de código (Sonar Cube)
  • Boa comunicação e autonomia técnica.


Precisamos de alguém com domínio em:

  • Angular 10+ e/ou React 15+
  • RxJS, Hooks, State Management (NgRx, Redux ou Context API)
  • Material UI ou similares
  • Bootstrap
  • Integrações com APIs RESTful
  • Design patterns (Observable, Strategy, Decorator, etc)

title: Desenvolvedor Python - Remoto
description:
A Getronics é líder global em soluções de tecnologia, com uma equipe de mais de 4.000 colegas em 22 países, fornecendo serviços abrangentes de ponta a ponta em todo o mundo. Temos o compromisso de oferecer um atendimento excepcional ao cliente, para permitir que eles se concentrem em seus principais pontos fortes, enquanto confiam suas necessidades de TI à Getronics. Temos uma oportunidade incrível para você se juntar à nossa equipe, na seguinte vaga: Desenvolvedor Python - Remoto.

O que oferecemos a você:

  • Assistência médica sem desconto para titulares;
  • Assistência odontológica sem desconto para titulares;
  • Cartão flex tanto para alimentação quanto refeição;
  • Auxílio home office para vaga remota;
  • Vale transporte para posições presenciais ou híbridas;
  • Auxílio creche;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Parceria com instituições de ensino;
  • Parceria com escolas de idiomas;
  • Programa de subsídio para aulas de inglês;
  • Programa de indicações: prêmio para indicações bem-sucedidas;
  • Licença maternidade estendida de 180 dias e a licença paternidade de 20 dias;
  • Treinamento completo fornecido como parte de um processo de indução robusto, incluindo oportunidades de desenvolvimento contínuo com nossa plataforma de aprendizado online NorthStar, LinkedIn Learning e Udemy, que possui mais de 80.000 cursos disponíveis;
  • GetVibes - nosso programa de escuta ativa que nos permite conectar e ouvir feedback de todos os colegas, e como empresa, trabalhamos juntos para elaborar planos de ação para melhorar e desenvolver continuamente a Getronics!


O que esperar desta posição:

Atuação em projetos estratégicos, desenvolvendo e aprimorando arquiteturas de software e soluções escaláveis, com foco em qualidade, segurança e alta performance.


O que esperamos de você:

Padrões Arquiteturais e Design de Software: Clean Architecture, Clean Code, DDD (Domain-Driven Design), SOA (Service-Oriented Architecture), MVC e MVVM.

Linguagem de Programação: Python.

Qualidade de Software: Testes unitários e automatizados com Sonar, JUnit, Mockito e Jasmine.

Arquitetura de Microservices, Web Service e Mensageria: APIs RESTful e SOAP, comunicação assíncrona, arquitetura orientada a eventos e microserviços.

Bancos de Dados e Servidores de Aplicações: DB2, Oracle (desejável NoSQL), JBoss e Apache Tomcat.

Segurança da Informação: Práticas de segurança, criptografia, autenticação e autorização (JWT).

DevOps: Docker, Kubernetes, Rancher, OpenShift, ArgoCD, Maven e Jenkins.

Arquitetura em Nuvem: AWS, Azure e Google Cloud.

Versionamento de Código: Git, com estratégias de branching e merging.

  • GetVibes - nosso programa de escuta ativa que nos permite conectar e ouvir feedback de todos os colegas, e como empresa, trabalhamos juntos para elaborar planos de ação para melhorar e desenvolver continuamente a Getronics!


O que esperar desta posição:

Atuação em projetos estratégicos, desenvolvendo e aprimorando arquiteturas de software e soluções escaláveis, com foco em qualidade, segurança e alta performance.


O que esperamos de você:

Padrões Arquiteturais e Design de Software: Clean Architecture, Clean Code, DDD (Domain-Driven Design), SOA (Service-Oriented Architecture), MVC e MVVM.

Linguagem de Programação: Python.

Qualidade de Software: Testes unitários e automatizados com Sonar, JUnit, Mockito e Jasmine.

Arquitetura de Microservices, Web Service e Mensageria: APIs RESTful e SOAP, comunicação assíncrona, arquitetura orientada a eventos e microserviços.

Bancos de Dados e Servidores de Aplicações: DB2, Oracle (desejável NoSQL), JBoss e Apache Tomcat.

Segurança da Informação: Práticas de segurança, criptografia, autenticação e autorização (JWT).

DevOps: Docker, Kubernetes, Rancher, OpenShift, ArgoCD, Maven e Jenkins.

Arquitetura em Nuvem: AWS, Azure e Google Cloud.

Versionamento de Código: Git, com estratégias de branching e merging.


O que fazer em seguida:

Caso você seja a pessoa que estamos procurando, aguarde nosso contato para te conhecermos melhor e siga as instruções durante o processo seletivo. Se você gostaria de fazer alguma pergunta sobre nossas vagas, sobre a Getronics como empresa ou qualquer outra coisa, por favor, não hesite em entrar em contato. A equipe de RH estará disponível no e-mail

title: Arquiteto de Software - CRM Dynamics 365
description:
Descrição da vaga

A FCamara está em busca de uma pessoa Arquiteto de Software , para se juntar a nossa equipe dinâmica e atuar em parceria com a maior construtora da América Latina, que ao longo de sua existência, sempre esteve sintonizada com o mercado e as melhores práticas, além de priorizar sempre as necessidades de seus clientes. É uma empresa que está em constante movimento, se reinventando a cada dia para oferecer soluções de moradia para todas as gerações.


Estamos em busca de um(a) Arquiteto(a) de Software experiente e estratégico(a), com sólida atuação em ambientes CRM e modernização de plataformas legadas. Este profissional será peça-chave na transformação tecnológica de nossos sistemas, atuando desde a análise técnica até o desenho de soluções modernas e escaláveis.


Responsabilidades e atribuições


Responsabilidades:

  • Analisar tecnicamente a implementação da plataforma CRM 4.0, identificando oportunidades de evolução e integração.
  • Liderar o processo de plataformação de sistemas legados, propondo arquiteturas robustas e alinhadas às melhores práticas de mercado.
  • Projetar e documentar soluções em aplicações modernas, com foco em CRM Dynamics 365 e tecnologias complementares.
  • Atuar como referência técnica nas decisões de direcionamento de solução, em parceria com o time especialista do cliente.
  • Garantir que as soluções propostas estejam alinhadas com os objetivos de negócio, escalabilidade e segurança.
  • Apoiar times de desenvolvimento na adoção das arquiteturas definidas, promovendo boas práticas e governança técnica.


Requisitos:

  • Experiência comprovada em arquitetura de software, especialmente em ambientes CRM.
  • Conhecimento profundo em Dynamics CRM 365, integração de sistemas e modernização de aplicações.
  • Vivência com análise e reengenharia de sistemas legados.
  • Habilidade de comunicação e colaboração com times multidisciplinares e clientes.
  • Capacidade de tomar decisões técnicas estratégicas com foco em valor de negócio.


Requisitos e qualificações


Diferenciais:

- Certificações em arquitetura de software ou CRM Dynamics.

- Experiência com metodologias ágeis e DevOps.

- Inglês técnico.

title: Consultor de Investimentos WS - Parceiros XP | Remoto
description:
Essa oportunidade é para consultor de investimento nas consultorias Wealth Service parceiras da rede XP, que tem a missão de ajudar o brasileiro a investir melhor. São times apaixonados por relacionamento com cliente, aprofundamento técnico sobre alocação de recursos e prospecção de novos negócios.


Principais Responsabilidades

  • Prospecção de novos clientes;
  • Atuação na consultoria de investimentos, sendo responsável por orientar o cliente final na gestão de patrimônio;
  • Elaboração de portfólio de investimentos em linha com o perfil e objetivo dos clientes;
  • Análise de alocações externas e elaboração de estudos comparativos exclusivos, identificando oportunidades e apresentando de forma objetiva;
  • Acompanhamento de tendências de mercado, se mantendo sempre informado sobre atualidades do cenário econômico e acontecimentos relevantes.


Informações Importantes

  • Trabalho remoto em diversas praças do país


Pré-Requisito

  • Perfil comercial e fortes habilidades de comunicação;
  • Alto nível de intensidade e disciplina;
  • Conhecimento sobre cenário econômico atual;
  • Experiência prévia em instituições financeiras;
  • Certificação CEA, CPF, CFA e/ou CGA (aceitável com prova agendada)


Você pode ter destaque se:

  • Possuir carteira de clientes para prospecção;
  • Ter base de clientes já estabelecida é um grande diferencial;
  • Conhecimentos sobre produtos financeiros;
  • Noções básicas de macroeconomia e atualidades.

title: Figma Graphic Designer for Email Marketing
description:
Figma Graphic Designer for Email Marketing

Location: Remote (US hours preferred)

Type: Full-time

Salary: $1,200 - $1,600 USD / month (depending on experience and skill level)


About Us

Rettain is a fast-growing email & SMS marketing agency working with amazing eCommerce brands across the US. We help brands connect with their customers through thoughtful design, smart strategy, and automation that drives results.


We’re looking for a Graphic Designer who’s an expert in Figma to design stunning emails that engage and convert for top eCommerce brands. We're looking for a designer who's passionate not only about design but also about libraries, components, systems, creative visuals, and AI tools. You’ll play a key role in shaping the visual identity of our clients’ email campaigns, combining creativity, precision, and innovation.


What You’ll Do

  • Design stunning emails that engage and convert for top eCommerce brands.
  • Build and maintain Figma libraries, components, and templates for efficient, scalable design workflows.
  • Use AI tools to generate unique visuals that elevate campaign creative.
  • Collaborate with copywriters, strategists, and developers to bring ideas to life.
  • Create cohesive, on-brand visuals across email, web, and digital assets.
  • Contribute to a learning-driven environment, constantly exploring new design and AI techniques.


What We’re Looking For

  • Strong graphic design skills: layout, typography, composition, color, and branding.
  • Expert-level Figma skills: components, variants, auto-layout, and libraries.
  • Experience designing for email marketing (is a plus).
  • Understanding of responsive design and user experience in email.
  • Familiarity or interest in AI image generation and creative workflows.
  • A growth mindset: you love learning and improving your craft.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills in a remote team environment.


Bonus Points For:

- Previous work with DTC or ecommerce brands.

- Expert in UX/UI and Figma Components.

- Expert in AI image generation


Why You’ll Love Working With Us

- Collaborate with ambitious brands that value creativity and performance.

- Work in a supportive, growth-oriented environment that encourages learning and innovation.

- Fully remote and flexible work setup.

title: Java Fullstack Developer SR
description:
Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home



Job Summary

We are seeking a highly skilled Java Full Stack Developer to join our dynamic team. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in both front-end and back-end development, with a passion for building scalable and efficient applications. As a Full Stack Developer, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining high-performance web applications that meet the needs of our clients and stakeholders.


Responsibilities and Duties

  • Development of new features;
  • Maintenance of existing applications;
  • Raise and discuss trade-offs of different design approaches elaborating detailed design documents;
  • Implement solution from coding to testing to production deployment support;
  • Perform code reviews.


Essential Skills

  • Proficiency in Backend Java and Java Spring Boot;
  • Experience with automated testing in Java (e.g. Unit Test, Integration Test, etc.);
  • Solid experience with Python;
  • Solid Front-end development experience, especially with React (or any other SPA)
  • Experience with Typescript;
  • Experience with Microservices Architecture;
  • Experience with modeling, producing and consuming web services-based APIs (RESTful or SOAP based);
  • Experience using AWS services;
  • Good knowledge on relational and non-relational databases, be able to work with Postgres and MongoDB;
  • Practical understanding of Git or similar VCS, CI/CD practices, with a preference for GitHub Actions or Jenkins;
  • Good communication skills in English.


Highly Desirable Skills

  • Experience with GraphQL;
  • Experience with agile development;
  • Familiarity with Message Brokers (RabbitMQ, Amazon SQS, etc);
  • Utilization of monitoring tools such as Sumo Logic, New Relic, Datadog, or equivalent solutions for troubleshooting and logging;


About Encora


Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.


At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.
